title.en: Designing Transformers for Continuous Diffusion Language Models

summary.en: LangDiT improves continuous diffusion language generation through normalization, noise conditioning, a calibrated likelihood shortcut, and confidence-gated self-conditioning.
summary.zh: 面向连续扩散语言模型设计 LangDiT，结合归一化、噪声条件、经校准的似然捷径与置信度门控自条件机制，提升语言生成能力。
